news.title: Living World Update
news.body:
The roads are no longer empty. Azeroth stirs with new life:

◆ Wandering heroes: adventurers roam the land, leveling, questing and braving dungeons beside you. Spot them with /who.
◆ The Auction House opens its doors: cloth, ore, herbs, potions, food and reagents for your level, plus spoils hauled back from the wilds. Fresh stock arrives all day, and listings last up to two days.
◆ Dungeons bend to your party: too few allies? Monsters weaken to match your numbers (and drop a little less gold), so a small band can still storm a full dungeon.
◆ Thrill of the Kill: the buff now shows your total bonus as the stacks climb.

news.title: New: Thrill of the Kill
news.body: Every kill now fuels the next. Each enemy you slay grants a stack of Thrill of the Kill: +1% damage done for 60 seconds, stacking up to 10 times (+10%). Every new kill refreshes the timer, so keep the momentum going! Player kills in PvP count too. Grey-level mobs and critters don't, so no farming rabbits. The launcher installs the client patch automatically; you'll see the buff on your bar after your first kill.

news.title: Welcome
news.body: The launcher keeps your client in sync with the server. Hit Play once it says Ready.
